guard/32180.htm.text: Marksman Kato: Yes, this is Kamael Village. If you go back the way you came, you will pass Mimir's Forest and arrive at the harbor. You should also pass Nornil's Cave.

links.text: See information on permanent residence and tax rates.

guard/32180-1.htm.text: Marksman Kato: The harbor was originally made to allow contact between the Isle of Souls and the mainland.
